question: What is the impact of a nondisruptive upgrade on fabric and modular switches?
options: The upgrade disrupts the control plane for more than 120 seconds.
During the upgrade, new devices cannot log in to the fabric.
If a zone server merge is in progress, the upgrade continues without interruption.
When the installation is complete, the system BIOS must be updated.
theory: Even a nondisruptive (hitless) ISSU keeps the data plane forwarding for devices already logged into the fabric, but the control-plane services that process new FLOGIs (fabric login, name-server registration) are briefly unavailable during the roughly 80-second control-plane switchover - so while existing traffic keeps flowing, any new device attempting to log in to the fabric during that window will be unable to do so until the control plane comes back online. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 11 - Nondisruptive Upgrade)
